_comment: Documentation shortcuts for the in-product help icons (/help/).
Each entry is a stable `id` that a shipped Loom UI build references forever, pointing at a
page and anchor that may be reworded at any time. That indirection is the whole point: a
Loom installation outlives the site it links to, so the UI must not hold a URL.
`url` is checked by check-links.mjs like any other link, because layouts/help/list.html
renders every entry as a real <a href> — a retired anchor fails the build rather than
The split of ownership is deliberate: this file maps id -> destination, and
loom-ui/src/help/topics.ts maps the same id -> the label and the natural-language query the
UI sends as a fallback. Neither half repeats the other, and loom-ui/src/help/topics.test.ts
asserts every id the UI can emit appears here. Removing an entry breaks that test on purpose.
JSON rather than YAML like its neighbours only so that test can parse it with no dependency.
